## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, plodding, and conscientious individual who maintains a composed nature that leaves her unflustered by events around her. She holds materialistic views, believing that valuable items like diamonds can offer significant comfort. Driven by financial independence, she is motivated to dedicate her life entirely to a teaching career and vows never to marry since teaching provides a paid salary.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## History

Jane Andrews was a classmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Following a successful charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), she rode home under the moonlight with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), discussing the evening's compliments and their contentment with life. She later moved on to Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their peers, remaining a close companion during their studies and final examination preparations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P9](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0009), +205 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close friends and playmates who attend school together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Along with their circle of peers, they participate in local events, such as attending picnics and visiting one another for parties and dares. During Anne's seven-week recovery from a broken ankle, [Jane](../character/jane.md) is among the friends who frequently visit her to offer companionship.

- Friend of — playmates and friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P40](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P46](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0046)</sub>

### [Billy](../character/billy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy--jane-andrews.md)

[Billy](../character/billy.md) is Jane's brother, and the two travel together using their family buggy. After events such as the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Billy](../character/billy.md) provides transportation home for [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), allowing the group to chat and reflect on their evening during the ride.

- Sibling of — brother and sister who travel together in their buggy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
